brief: Responsive commerce website for an independent urban bicycle retailer. First-time riders need fit and use-case confidence before buying. Show real bikes, prices, workshop service, local test rides, and a clear purchase path.
Municipal online service for residents to check permit eligibility, apply, upload documents, track status, and recover from missing evidence. Multilingual responsive web, high stakes.
Pediatric care mobile app for parents to triage symptoms, book appointments, manage medication reminders, and understand when to seek urgent care.
Independent literary magazine platform publishing long-form fiction, criticism, themed issues, authors, archives, events, and paid membership.
Keyboard-first warehouse operations workspace for dispatchers managing live inventory, exceptions, transfers, receiving, and audit history on desktop.
Website and shop for an experimental musician: releases, performances, essays, limited physical editions, listening, and direct fan purchase. Expressive brand but no assumed animation.
